HOSTING_RT_SAFETY_CODES.doc: The hosting codes of the rt-safety dimension: hosting.rt-safety.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

rtSafetyClean.doc: suitable: the interposer counted no allocation, lock or system call on the audio thread over the armed blocks with every parameter swept

text.en: The plugin showed no real-time safety violation under the sweep. It passed clean.

rtSafetyNotReproducible.doc: unknown: the interposer's counts varied between runs of the same plugin

text.en: The real-time safety measurement could not be reproduced. Measure it again before trusting it.

rtSafetyNotesClean.doc: suitable: played under the interposer, the plugin made no allocation, lock or system call

text.en: The plugin showed no real-time safety violation while playing notes. It passed clean.

rtSafetyNotesUnmeasured.doc: unknown: the plugin takes notes and was not played under the interposer; the parameter sweep alone says nothing about a voice

text.en: The plugin’s real-time safety while playing notes has not been measured. Measure it before relying on it.

rtSafetyNotesViolations.doc: conditional: played under the interposer, the plugin allocated, locked or made a system call; it runs in a worker of its own

text.en: The plugin violated real-time safety while playing notes. Treat it as not real-time safe with notes.

rtSafetyOwnThreads.doc: conditional: the plugin started threads of its own at instantiate (counted from /proc/self/task); a worker thread is not RT-unsafe, so the plugin still shares a worker (D20)

text.en: The plugin starts threads of its own beside its audio. It is real-time safe, and it can share a worker; its threads share the cores with the audio.

rtSafetyUnmeasured.doc: unknown: no interposer count was taken with every parameter swept (or the plugin has none to sweep), so the audio thread was never traced

text.en: The plugin’s real-time safety has not been measured. Measure it before relying on it.

rtSafetyViolations.doc: conditional: the interposer counted allocations, locks or system calls on the audio thread over the armed blocks; the plugin runs in a worker of its own, never grouped with RT-safe plugins

text.en: The plugin violated real-time safety during the run. Treat it as not real-time safe.
